title: RAG Agents in Prod: 10 Lessons We Learned — Douwe Kiela, creator of RAG
talk_summary: Douwe Kiela argues enterprise RAG success depends more on the surrounding system—specialized pipelines, production readiness, iteration, workflow integration, and observability—than on the base model. He shares ten lessons from Contextual AI, emphasizing systems over models, specialization over generalist AGI, and handling inaccuracy via audit trails and attribution.

takeaways.technique: Optimize the system, not just the model
takeaways.what_they_do: They treat the model as one component and optimize the retrieval/agent pipeline around it; a mediocre model with a strong pipeline beats a strong model with a bad pipeline.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you should be thinking about systems not about models the model is only a small part of the system

takeaways.what_they_do: They specialize systems for domain-specific use cases rather than relying on generalist AGI.
takeaways.evidence_quote: specialize for it and you'll get much further

takeaways.technique: Design for production from day one
takeaways.what_they_do: They avoid pilot-only designs and build for production scale, security, and real usage from the start.
takeaways.evidence_quote: don't design for the pilot design for production

takeaways.technique: Speed over perfection with real feedback
takeaways.what_they_do: They ship barely functional versions to real users early and hill-climb from feedback rather than waiting for perfection.
takeaways.evidence_quote: speed is really much more important than Perfection

takeaways.what_they_do: They abstract repetitive RAG chores like chunking and prompting so engineers focus on business value.
takeaways.evidence_quote: make sure that your engineers spend time on the things that matter and not on the chunking strategy

takeaways.what_they_do: They treat accuracy as table stakes and use observability, audit trails, and attribution to manage the missing 5-10%.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the way to deal with that is through observability
